## Intro Thoughts


```{r}
data_replace <- function(fun = NULL) {

  structure(
    list(new_fun_specification = fun), 
    class = "data_replace"
    )

}



#' @import ggplot2
#' @importFrom ggplot2 ggplot_add
#' @export
ggplot_add.data_replace <- function(object, plot, object_name) {
  
  test_fun <- function(){
    
    aes()
    
  }

  
  plot + test_fun()

}




ggplot(mtcars) + 
  aes(cyl) + 
  geom_bar() + 
  data_replace()

last_plot() + 
  data_replace()

last_plot() + 
  data_replace(test_fun)

```


## Status Quo

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# use ggplot_add
# don't make assumption about name of var
ggbugs <- function(fun = NULL) {

  structure(
    list(fun_spec = fun), 
    class = "ggbugs"
    )

}

#' @import ggplot2
#' @importFrom ggplot2 ggplot_add
#' @export
ggplot_add.ggbugs <- function(object, plot, object_name) {
  
  plot +
    object$fun_spec()
    
}

two_plus_two <- function(){ 2+2}

ggplot() + ggbugs(two_plus_two)
```
